## Core Projects
- **MLOps Experiment Tracking & Model Registry System**:
  - Implemented scikit-learn models (optimized ElasticNet reaching 82% R² in experimental runs).
  - Instrumented automated metric logging (RMSE, MAE, R²) and artifact storage using MLflow and DAGsHub remote tracking.
  - Reproducible environments managed via Git and Conda.
- **LCEL Chatbot Application**:
  - Engineered LLM interaction pipelines using LangChain Expression Language (LCEL).
  - Built low-latency REST endpoints using FastAPI and LangServe.
  - Integrated Groq high-throughput hosted inference with dynamic prompt templates and output parsers.
- **Bank Customer Churn Prediction System**:
  - Supervised classification using an Artificial Neural Network (ANN) built with TensorFlow/Keras.
  - Incorporated feature engineering, StandardScaler, and dropout regularization.
  - Monitored training dynamics via TensorBoard; built Streamlit inference interface.
- **Student Performance Regression Pipeline**:
  - Benchmarked multiple regression algorithms using scikit-learn (achieved R² = 0.88).
  - Constructed leak-free preprocessing pipelines with ColumnTransformer, OneHotEncoder, and StandardScaler.
